title: RiverQuest
specs: Stable, handicap accessible vessel with enclosed cabin and heater
Bluetooth music system, PA system, and 42" display monitor onboard
Children of any age allowed on private cruise
includes: ½ hour before cruise for set-up
gap: Age minimum not stated for public cruises
blurb: Guests can book private charters for exclusive two-hour cruises on the Connecticut River with a captain and crew. The vessel has an enclosed cabin with heating, a Bluetooth music system, PA system, and a display monitor for presentations. Food and beverages are supplied by guests, with alcohol allowed (wine and beer suggested).
extraNote: $250 non-refundable deposit due when date/time confirmed · If operator cancels due to weather, full refund or reschedule offered · No charge if guest cancels by email within 24 hours of departure · Guests forfeit money if late or no-show · Connecticut River Museum dock
